summary: Brookfield Infrastructure Corp filed a Form 6-K with a guarantee indenture dated August 27, 2026, among Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P., BIPC Holdings Inc., Brookfield Infrastructure L.P., and Computershare Trust Company of Canada. The indenture establishes guarantees for Class A Preferred LP Unit obligations. This is a routine financial arrangement, not a special situation. No change of control, strategic action, or unusual corporate event is disclosed. The filing supports ongoing capital structure operations, likely a preferred unit issuance. What to watch: no special-situation angle; this is routine financing documentation.
